formula: Enumerate all2^8 sign changes of opening-pair score minus0.5; include ties and the observed assignment.
interpretation: The descriptive normal95 lower bound50.409% is not robust evidence of superiority: only three informative positive pairs. Under sign-exchangeability, tail probabilities are0.125/0.25.
limitations: Post-selection reused development roots; sign-exchangeability and opening independence are assumptions, not verified randomization.
This sensitivity is not an independent confirmatory p-value and does not replace the predeclared bounded interval.
